topic: Roth vs traditional retirement accounts, the real difference
title: Roth vs. Traditional: What's the Real Difference?
description:
Everyone talks about Roth and Traditional retirement accounts, but the core difference is simple. It all comes down to one question: do you want to pay taxes now or later? We break down how each account works so you can understand the choice.
